dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds deep expert knowledge: exact upgrade ordering (add‑ons → control plane → node groups), concrete version‑compatibility matrices, deprecated‑API tables, cost/time baselines, recent AWS features (Auto Mode, Hybrid Nodes, Access Entries, Pod Identity). Missing: detailed IAM‑role permission checks, cross‑account considerations, Karpenter‑specific upgrade handling.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides AWS‑specific procedures: precise CLI flags, confirm‑gate workflow, pre‑check priority list, and post‑verification steps. Weakness: some steps are generic (e.g., "run kubent" without version flag) and no explicit fallback plan for a failed control‑plane upgrade.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a concrete NEVER list with specific reasons (add‑on sequencing, one‑way control‑plane upgrade, PDB drain blocking, resolve‑conflicts handling, deprecated‑API scan). Lacks anti‑patterns around IAM permission errors and pagination pitfalls beyond a brief mention.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Full frontmatter, clear description of WHAT it does, WHEN to invoke, exhaustive keyword list, activation triggers, and a precise invocation schema. No missing or vague elements.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (quick reference, mindset, pre‑flight, process, output format). Critical safety rules (e.g., rollback advisory) are repeated deep in the document, and the size of the skill may overload an agent before it reaches the needed section.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive operations are tightly constrained with confirm gates, version‑skip checks, and capacity validation. Some flexibility remains (e.g., surge parameters are not bounded by explicit limits) and IAM‑role validation is only mentioned generically.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (What it does → Quick navigation → Mindset → Process → Output → Anti‑Patterns). Structure is coherent, though section naming is slightly ad‑hoc rather than a standard template.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides decision trees, concrete CLI commands, example outputs, and error‑handling notes. Missing: explicit handling of pagination errors, detailed remediation steps for failed CLI calls, and some placeholders remain (e.g., <update-id-from-step-2>) requiring runtime substitution.
